lines: Hold me tightly once more at the end.
After that I need nothing else.
My future, my past, everything.
If I'm filled with you, I have no regrets.
Carving proof of being alive, shaking my trembling heart.
I don't need a scale, my mind is bewildered by contradictions.
To the point where justice and evil waver.
The end credits of a life rushed.
Surely a selfish prank of the gods.
I don't mind being the dirty role.
Full of contradictions, we're both the same, a contest of miserable tales.
A single skin of the neck on the brink.
Struggling is just transparent.
A fragment of yearning.
Send it, send it, letting blood circulate.
I stare single‑mindedly, needing no reason.
Without knowing why I weep, love tore my body apart.
Don't brandish righteousness; facts ripped the reason apart.
I stoke fire in the clamor so the heartbeat won't stop.
Even laying a blanket feels uncouth.
Now look forward to the next life, shine and flash at breakneck speed.
I head straight ahead, leaving no reserve.
Send it, send it, letting blood circulate.
I love single‑mindedly; eternity is unnecessary.
Hold me tightly once more at the end.
After that I need nothing else.
Even the unseen future and the past that cannot be erased.
If I'm filled with you, I have no regrets.
At the end once more, lend me your strength.
After that I need nothing else.
My future, my heart, my body.
I'll give them all to you, everything.
